configuration.status: frozen before pilot and main hedge outcomes
configuration.authorization: Author requested completion of the staged simulation procedure; numerical choices below are implementation choices for this bounded study.
configuration.parameter_source: Poulsen, Schenk-Hoppe and Ewald (2009), Table 2, https://d-nb.info/1191914100/34; original estimates attributed there to Eraker (2004)
configuration.option: European call; strike = strike_over_forward * spot0 * exp(rate * maturity)
configuration.error_persistence: fixed for every path and date in its scenario; sensitivity scenarios, not a calibrated error distribution
configuration.initial_endowment: reference-Q call price at time zero, identical for all strategies and scenarios within a contract
configuration.fees: proportional to absolute traded stock value at opening, every rebalance, and terminal liquidation; paid from cash once
configuration.funding: cash accrues daily at exp(rate/252), including negative balances; no dividends or constraints
configuration.input_updates: daily reference-Q call prices and contract-specific BS IV; true simulated current variance; histories fixed independently of trading schedule and structural scenario
configuration.path_method: full-truncation latent-variance Euler with log-stock update; supplied variance=max(latent variance,0)

convergence.scope: all six contracts, nine input scenarios, three fees and two schedules

configuration.primary_outcome: mean squared terminal portfolio-minus-payoff error, currency squared per one option on one share; no cross-contract pooling
contrasts: plain Heston MSE minus BS MSE
adjusted Heston MSE minus plain Heston MSE
configuration.uncertainty: paired IID-path mean squared-loss differences; Student-t approximate 95% pointwise intervals and Bonferroni simultaneous intervals across all 648 prespecified contrasts; no equivalence test
configuration.mc_checks: report prespecified first-2048 versus all-4096 estimates, squared-loss concentration and eight consecutive 512-path batch estimates; no optional stopping
configuration.numerical_checks: independent QuantLib prices and finite-difference Greeks, IV repricing, deterministic cash-ledger checks, path moments, and coupled 8-versus-16-substep hedge losses
configuration.numerical_interpretation: Report paired change and confidence interval from refinement beside the main contrast; call sign numerically stable only if its simultaneous main interval remains on the same side of zero after expanding by abs(refinement change) + 1.96*refinement SE. This is a conservative diagnostic, not a bound on undiscovered bias.
configuration.failure_policy: count fallbacks and boundary events; fail the run on unhandled nonfinite prices, holdings, IV or accounting; no path exclusions or silent replacement; disclose floating-point boundary conventions
configuration.scope_limits: one generating regime; true variance observed; no empirical backtest, jumps, joint parameter errors, calibration runtime or variance-state estimation study
